column3: number sign at the start of a word; ڻ everywhere else
column4: No ordinary Sindhi word begins with ڻ. The aspirate ڻھ does, and its cells are also the fraction 1/8. The 21,445 figure once quoted here was wrong: the list holds 2,704 spellings, 23,432 counting how often each occurs.

column3: زبر when it follows a letter inside a word; ڪاما after a completed word
column4: Riaz: "a letter written first and then zer, zabar or pesh" — diacritics always follow their letter. OPEN: this conflicts with his 15 Aug 2026 instruction that the shadda in الله falls between the two lams, and with Urdu braille, which writes the shadda before the letter it doubles. On sheet 4.
